invariants: Dream never modifies staleness_state — only confidence values
Dream only reads from .wabblespec/state/memory/wings/ — never from receipts or plans
gap-map.md and staleness-map.md are always overwritten on each run — not appended
dream-log.json is append-only — runs are never removed or edited
Dry-run produces identical stdout output but writes no files

validation_gate.phase_4_gate: 10 runs in dream-log.json AND at least one gap finding led to a drawer update
validation_gate.theater_test: If 10 runs produce zero findings and no drawer is ever updated: thresholds need tuning
